# Imverica Legal Solutions

> Imverica Legal Solutions (Imverica LLC) is a Sacramento-based document-preparation company. Its founder is a California-registered and bonded Legal Document Assistant (LDA) and Immigration Consultant (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §§6400-6415, §§22440-22448). Direct services are delivered remotely to California self-represented clients, only at the client's specific direction, in English, Russian, Ukrainian, and Spanish. In a separate business-to-business engagement, nonlawyer support may be provided to a licensed attorney under that attorney's direction and review. Imverica is not a law firm.

## Quick facts

- Business name: Imverica Legal Solutions (legal entity: Imverica LLC)
- Base: Sacramento, California; services are delivered remotely (no public residential address is presented as an office)
- Direct client service area: California self-represented clients
- Attorney support: separate assignments may be accepted from licensed attorneys under their direction and review
- Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish
- Phone: +1 (916) 399-3992 · Email: info@imverica.com
- Registration: California Legal Document Assistant and Immigration Consultant, registered and bonded
- Experience: more than 10 years preparing immigration documents, including prior paralegal work under the direction of California-licensed attorneys
- Not a law firm; for direct clients there is no legal advice, form selection, eligibility determination, strategy, outcome prediction, or representation
- Flat published fees: https://imverica.com/pricing

## Who we help

Ukrainians who arrived through Uniting for Ukraine (U4U), Russian-speaking and Spanish-speaking immigrants, families filing USCIS petitions, TPS applicants, work-permit and green-card applicants, and Californians handling their own court paperwork (small claims, family law, eviction, probate, record cleanup).

## Immigration document services

- [U4U-related preparation](https://imverica.com/u4u): client-selected Uniting for Ukraine-related documents. Russian/Ukrainian pages: https://imverica.com/ru/u4u, https://imverica.com/ua/u4u
- [TPS-related preparation](https://imverica.com/tps): client-selected TPS forms and supporting-document organization; current designation and eligibility questions belong with USCIS or an attorney
- [Work permit I-765](https://imverica.com/i-765-work-permit-help)
- [Green card / adjustment I-485](https://imverica.com/i-485-help)
- [Family petition I-130](https://imverica.com/i-130-family-petition)
- [Fiance petition I-129F](https://imverica.com/i-129f-fiance-visa-document-preparation)
- [Asylum I-589 document preparation](https://imverica.com/i-589-asylum-help)
- [Citizenship N-400](https://imverica.com/n-400-citizenship-help)
- [Travel document I-131](https://imverica.com/i-131-travel-document)
- [Immigration overview — all forms](https://imverica.com/immigration)
- Certified Ukrainian/Russian/Spanish → English translations
- EOIR work is offered only as separate paralegal support to licensed attorneys under their direction and review

## Compliance

Imverica Legal Solutions is not a law firm and is not a substitute for an attorney. For direct clients, Imverica does not provide legal advice, choose forms or evidence, determine eligibility, recommend strategy, predict outcomes, or provide representation. Documents are prepared solely at the client's specific direction. Questions requiring legal judgment should go to a licensed attorney.
